title: Web-first specific paper lookup
description: Simplifies specific-paper lookup: use native websearch/webfetch first, keep arc_lookup_paper only as a fallback, and reserve arc_search_literature for topic-level literature review.
changes: Route concrete paper requests to native websearch/webfetch first.
Limit query expansion to the original phrase plus one or two focused variants.
Use arc_lookup_paper only when websearch/webfetch cannot find a clear paper page.
Keep arc_search_literature for broad topic search, survey, related work, and literature review tasks.
Reject candidates that match only versions, years, numbers, or generic words.

rollback.notes: Restore the previous parallel academic lookup plus native websearch/webfetch protocol.
